about_the_game:
Dysterra Founder’s Pack

The Founder’s Pack DLC includes the following benefits over the free package:

💰 3,000TP for Terra Shop

By using 3,000 TP, you can purchase a large number of items from the TerraShop and unlock various cosmetic and functional features on the official servers.

🖥️ Access to the official servers

Join the official servers, maintained long-term by the developers, to team up with other players or dive into endless competition and cooperation.

🏆 Listed on the global rankings

Performance from PvP and PvE official servers is separately totaled and reflected in the global rankings.

🎁 Ability to claim daily/weekly rewards

A reward of 30 TP is given for logging in each day. Additionally, for each official server you play on, you’ll receive weekly TP rewards based on your performance, which can be used in the TerraShop.

🔓 Unlocks some content in single-player and custom servers
